DZA.note: Plans a unified national civil-status database but states no link between the civil register and the ID system.
A draft civil-status law on digitisation and a planned unified database; no digital registration system procured, piloted or in service is stated.
Mentions protecting civil-status data in general terms; no data protection law is stated.
No ID number given at birth is mentioned.
Police station records are not mentioned.
Only a draft law and a planned database; no office-level digital entry of births or deaths is stated.
